title: fix(plugin-security): uninstall revokes only the grants bound to the package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3fou5fTrUSsx21CCMCRXUK)_

Fixes #32160

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 卸载一个包时，只撤销绑定到这个包的权限集授权，以及没有写明包的授权。绑定到别的包的授权不再被误删。没写明包、但同名权限集仍有别的包持有的授权，照样撤销，并在一条告警和卸载回执的 `reportedGrants` 里列出用户、组织和权限集名。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0150 允许两个包各自持有同名权限集（#31698 的放宽）。按旧逻辑，卸载 gamma 会连带撤销用户对 delta 同名权限集的授权，而 delta 仍在。所以这张卡要先于 #31698 PR-2 落地。
- **风险与回滚：** 今天安装仍拒绝第二个持有者，所以线上每个卸载回答都和以前一样。回执只多一个可选字段，单持有者时不出现。回滚只需 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/cleanup-package-permissions.ts` 的授权循环（包过滤和告警），`security-plugin-start-hooks.ts` 的清理注册（持有者读取器和回执），`protocol-class-head.ts` 的 `runUninstallCleanups`（字段转交）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts`，预期 19 个测试全绿，其中 9 个是本卡新增的 ADR-0150 D8 用例。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`cleanupPackagePermissions` (plugin-security).** It still selects the grants naming each declared set, but now revokes a grant only when its `permission_set_package` is the uninstalled package, or the column is empty or blank. A grant bound to another package is never touched.
- **Empty-column grants.** They are revoked in every case. The function takes an optional holder reader (`options.catalog`, the security catalog's `list('permission')`). It is read once per uninstall, and only when an empty-column grant was revoked. If another holder still serves the name after the withdrawal, the grant is reported: one `warn` per uninstall naming each grant's user, organization and set, the remaining holders, and the remedy (grant it again with the package named), plus `reportedGrants` on the outcome. A reader that throws reports every such grant, because nobody could say it had one holder. A catalog entry that still names the withdrawn package is not counted as another holder. ⛔ The grant is never bound to the remaining holder. No write except the deletes happens, and a pin asserts that.
- **The call site (`security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`).** The registered `security.package-permissions` cleanup passes a reader built by `createSecurityCatalogReader({ registry, metadata })`, the same reader the boot reports already build, and answers `reportedGrants` when there are any.
- **The receipt (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`).** `UninstallCleanup`'s result and `UninstallCleanupOutcome` gain the optional `reportedGrants: Array<{ user, organization, permission_set }>`. `runUninstallCleanups` copies it onto the outcome when it is non-empty. `deletePackage` and install-local's `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` relay the outcomes verbatim, so both answers carry it. Neither shape is a `packages/spec` schema.
- Function header and the "a name belongs to one holder" comment are rewritten to the D8 rule.

## Tests

- `cleanup-package-permissions.test.ts`, the D8 block (seeded rows plus a seeded holder reader, because install still refuses a second holder):
  - two holders, each with a bound grant: uninstalling gamma leaves delta's grant, asserted by id and by its `permission_set_package`; plus the mirror control;
  - a null-column grant (and a blank one) with one holder: revoked, no report, no warn;
  - a null-column grant with two holders: revoked and reported on `reportedGrants` and in one `warn` naming user, organization, set, the remaining holder and the remedy. Never bound: `update` throws if called, and is asserted not called; the only grant of the name left is delta's, by id;
  - an unreadable reader reports; a leftover entry naming the withdrawn package is not a holder; the reader is read once, and not at all without an empty-column revocation.
- The wired block boots `SecurityPlugin`, takes the cleanup it registers with the protocol, and asserts its outcome is `{ success, removed, reportedGrants }` with a registry holder left, and `{ success, removed }` (unchanged) without one.
- `protocol.uninstall-cleanups-runner.test.ts`: the runner relays `reportedGrants` onto the outcome and onto `deletePackage`'s answer; an empty list adds nothing.
- `marketplace-install-local-uninstall-cleanups.test.ts`: the install-local `DELETE` answer carries an outcome's `reportedGrants` verbatim.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

All tests read `src` directly (relative imports), so no dist preflight applies.

| # | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | package filter: `return column === undefined \|\| column === packageId \|\| 'ABLATED-1';` | 6 failed, including "two holders, each with a bound grant: uninstalling one leaves the other's grant" |
| 2 | report gate: `if (others.length >= 0) continue; // ABLATED-2` | 3 failed (two-holder report, unreadable reader, wired outcome) |
| 3 | call-site relay of `reportedGrants` removed | 1 failed (wired outcome) |
| 4 | runner relay renamed to `ablated4` | 1 failed (runner relay) |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Step 0 readings: the reader is the security catalog's `list('permission')` over the engine registry (one entry per `(package, name)` holder, ADR-0150 D4). Both doors withdraw the package before they run the cleanups (`protocol-package-uninstall.ts`, `captureUninstallDeclared` then `registry.uninstallPackage` then `runUninstallCleanups`), so the list is read after the withdrawal.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: the optional `reportedGrants` member widens the uninstall answer. With one holder every answer is unchanged.
- No live probe was run. The two-holder state is not reachable until #31698 narrows.

## Verification

The gate run on the final head (derived families under the lock, reconciled with `--ran`) is in the os-dev-report comment on #32160.
